matching.type: exact native floor ID + union of wall structural-core mask in floor-local coordinates
matching.sourceSignatures: contact-plan.json stores actual clipped native triangle contact geometry and full local wall mask WKT for each part. Exact key match only; no scale/reflection.
matching.algorithm: Transform structural core footprint union into source-floor local XY, clip against actual pinned floor upper bevel triangles; choose an authored family member whose contact-patch union and bottom profile match within1micrometre. Alternatively exact fixture maps provide validated placements. Unknown masks reject, never silently substitute a perimeter ring.
matching.instanceIdentity: Part ID/asset UUID is reusable. Parent assigns distinct stable placed IDs from floor identity + mask key; preserve floor/object identities.

proof.gameSealAndFlowDefinitions: explicit parent authority input required; no real-world pressure or art-derived capabilities

limits: Only the22 authored signatures and18 tested no-opening configurations are covered.
Door frame/gasket/threshold sequence remains separately pinned r001/r002/r003 work; do not overlay blindly or claim door seals from this kit.
Contact inserts are actual shallow solids, not replacement floor visual or a logical airtight patch.
All wedge interiors are disjoint; internal contact faces remain in native compound meshes.
Roof butt contacts and material game definitions remain separate.
No pressure capacity, mass, HP, power, initial gas or runtime damage inferred.
